notes.title: General Update 1 is here! 🐶
notes.content:
Hello there, Roberto's friends! 👋

We're happy to announce the General Update 1 for Stick to the Plan! We bring several updates like:


 🐾 Added a dynamic loading screen, with a funny animation of Roberto's paw.
 🎮 Enhanced the Control Remapper functionality and visibility. Also, now controls menu is more accessible than ever!
 💬 Added Català language so users from Catalonia can better enjoy the game!
 🪛 Fixed lots of little user experience bugs.
 🛏️ Stick to the Plan is now Steam Deck verified, so you can be sure you will enjoy the experience from your couch, bed or throne too!
 🫣  We're getting ready for a cool announcement anytime soon. Maybe...  Stick to the Plan on Nintendo Switch?


Thank you very much for playing Stick to the Plan. We're launching a 20% discount from 14 to 27 November, so it's the best time to enjoy Roberto's adventures!

--------

Don't forget to follow us on Twitter and join our Discord Server!

notes.title: Accessibility Update: control re-mapping and minor bugs!
notes.content:
Hello, Roberto's friends!

Today we bring great news: the first update of Stick to the Plan is here! We bring several stuff like:


 It is now possible to switch the game between window and full screen.
 A menu has been added to configure the keys of keyboard and controller buttons, and be able to use ANY controller. Yes, even Guitar Hero drums.
Smoothed out the darkness of the Firefly Forest, which was a problem in some screens.
 Fixed minor functionality and user experience bugs.


Thank you very much for playing Stick to the Plan! And if you don't have it yet, remember that the 20% offer is available until the 19th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43757200/d3c20292c0d7a0b36888d4aec706266532bc2a73.png

notes.title: Day 1 Hotfix!
notes.content:
Some hotfixes for Day 1!


"A stick to govern them all" achievement now correctly working
Going to a goal without stick don't break the game anymore correctly working
Finishing levels in different order don't break the game neither!


Thanks for the patience and for playing! <3

notes.title: Roberto is nominated for 5 awards and wins Best Gameplay at IndieGG! 🏆
notes.content:
Last week, we took Stick to the Plan to two significant videogame expos for the first time, major stages for indies: The Indie Zone at Dreamhack and IndieGG, part of TenerifeGG 🎮

The reception from the public was phenomenal: people just couldn't stop playing until they finished all the puzzles in the demo, and the feedback we received was overwhelmingly positive and truly motivating. We also got to meet many other studios that are creating super fun games. But the excitement doesn't end there! 😱

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43757200/8a52f96fd7b9d02859ed4153293a788b585817b3.png

Stick to the Plan was nominated for 5 awards at IndieGG:

 Best Art
 Best Gameplay
 Best Pitch
 Most Innovative Game
 Absolute Best Game


And, in the end, we won the award for Best Gameplay! It's an honor to say this, as the other nominated games were outstanding titles (like Luto) that so many people adore. Additionally, the award was presented by the CEO of The Game Kitchen, the company behind titles like Blasphemous. A true honor for our team! ✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43757200/ab65ecce8314df30da634f8f25262a5778cbeb03.png

These days have been intense but motivating. We'll have more news about Stick to the Plan very soon. We can hint that we'll be participating in the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase. See you there! 🐶

💬 And DON'T FORGET TO JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER! 💬
